title: Title & Registration Services Late-Penalty Reimbursement: Kestrel's Penalty End Date and Total Days Late
content:
For a Title & Registration Services late-penalty reimbursement, Kestrel's penalty end date is the order's most recent submission date when the state returned the order for a lien information error and the order was submitted again after that return; it is the date of the order's latest document when the state returned the order for a document from the customer, no lien information error return stands, and the order was submitted again after its most recent return; otherwise it is the order's first submission date. The penalty's total days late are the calendar days from the order's opening date to Kestrel's penalty end date, less the registration state's dealer deadline days, never below zero.

## Terms on the records

- The order's most recent submission date is the submission date shown on the title order; it is "after" a return when it is later than that return's date.
- A return for a document from the customer is a state rejection for a missing signature, insurance not verified, emissions not on file or an odometer discrepancy.
- The first submission date is the date the order's title fee was remitted to the state.

| Registration state | AZ | TX | GA | FL | NC | OH | PA | CO |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dealer deadline days | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 28 | 30 | 20 | 30 |

## Order of application

| Lien information error return, submitted again after it | Customer-document return, no lien return, submitted again after the most recent return | Kestrel's penalty end date |
|---|---|---|
| yes | not relevant | the most recent submission date |
| no | yes | the date of the latest document |
| no | no | the first submission date |

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A PA order opened 1 March, first submitted 28 March, returned for a lien information error on 5 April and submitted again on 14 April: the end date is 14 April, 44 calendar days after opening; less PA's 20 days gives 24 total days late. Without the lien return, the end date would be the first submission date, 28 March: 27 days, less 20, gives 7.
